_schema: 10 character stories, ~5 fragments each. Each fragment is a note / letter / journal page / inscription / etc. written in-world. id is globally unique. discoveryHint is the player-facing teaser shown for undiscovered fragments — written to nudge toward the right biome / location. kind ∈ note|letter|journal|fragment is the cosmetic UI label.

stories.characterBlurb: The Aetheric Engine's chief architect. His personal logs trace the empire's last week from triumph to mud, sentence by sentence.

fragments.title: Personal Log, Year One of the Engine
fragments.body: The Engine breathes. We have named the particles 'Aetherons' — they oscillate at frequencies our finest instruments can barely chart, and the resonance is self-sustaining. The Empire's energy question is answered. Tomorrow we begin overclocking. The Council is jubilant. I will be remembered.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in the ruined laboratories of Thametan's Tower

fragments.title: Note, scratched in haste
fragments.body: The Engine is past its margins. Atoms in the south chamber are excited — visibly excited, you can SEE the iron rims of the conduit shimmering. Resonance is climbing. Coupling factor lost. We are recalibrating. I do not know what we will find on the other side of this hour.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near Thametan's Tower

fragments.title: Letter to the Council
fragments.body: Tremors are not seismic. The Engine has struck a sympathy with the geological substratum — every stratum of mud and rock under Tartaria is now part of the resonance field. I am writing this from the upper rooms because the lower rooms are no longer here.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in Samarran

fragments.title: Stained Page
fragments.body: A substance is rising from the floor. Not water. Not mud. Something that thinks slowly enough that the thought arrives as motion. It climbs the walls in defiance of gravity, and where it touches, the stone forgets what it was. I am running out of dry pages.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in the Mud Flood Nexus

fragments.title: Final Entry — Upper Tower
fragments.body: I built a thing to feed an empire and the thing has decided what an empire is. I am at the top of my own tower watching the city below me become a slow, humming pond. The Aether does not grieve. The mud does not grieve. The hubris was mine alone. — Zalmar.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the very top of Thametan's Tower

stories.characterBlurb: A Mud Monarch enforcer who burned histories for a living, then found one he could not burn. Six reports recovered from his kit.

fragments.title: Field Order — Varakush
fragments.body: INSTRUCTION: Enter the Forgotten Order enclaves at Varakush. Identify any recovered historical texts. Burn what you can carry to the brazier. Burn what you cannot, in place. Do not read. Reading is for the Council. — Department of Continuity.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a side passage of Varakush

fragments.title: Personal Report B
fragments.body: Today I lifted a Tartarian writing tablet from a sealed shelf. The carving showed the Giants. Not as monsters. As architects, drawing on a city plan with three figures gathered around them. The figures were children. The Giants were teaching.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near a Tartarian Giant relic

fragments.title: Diary Entry — clean-up mission
fragments.body: Istanbul. Underground archive. Three rooms of paper older than every government on every honest map. We worked until dawn. The brazier did not stop hungry. The Council called it 'consolidating the record.' I called it nothing, because I had stopped calling things by their names.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a buried city archive

fragments.title: Report D — flagged: do not file
fragments.body: The child manifested. Sparks across her hands the way Aether wants to leave the body. I was supposed to silence her. I was trained for it. I am writing this because I did not — and because I cannot write what I did instead. May the Council read this if I am dead before they ask.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found among Mud Monarch dead-drop letters

fragments.title: Unsent Letter — to the Council of Sovereigns
fragments.body: You rule a world that stands on a graveyard. You know the graveyard. You walk above it every day and pretend the humming you hear is the wind. I am no longer your hand. Whatever you do to me, do it without my help. — A Cloak no longer black.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near the body of a former Monarch agent

fragments.title: Map, hand-drawn
fragments.body: A folded square of oilskin. Tartarian relics marked in red. Names crossed out in a careful hand. At the bottom: 'I could not burn these. Someone better than me, find them. — B.'
fragments.discoveryHint: Found beside a skeleton in a dark alley

stories.characterBlurb: A True Tartarian who shaped the catacombs by hand. Five stone tablets, in careful chisel-work, in the order he carved them.

fragments.title: First Tablet — a prayer
fragments.body: Giants of the Old Land. Strength for the hands. Patience for the back. Let me shape the Aetherstone-mud into a home that remembers its makers. Let it know us. Let it keep us. So I have begun.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in the upper catacombs

fragments.title: Second Tablet — discovery
fragments.body: I broke through a wall today and found a family at their dinner table. Perfect. Untouched by time. The mud preserved them at the moment the food was set down. I did not speak. I touched no plate. I will move them to the deep gallery with honors.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near the buried cities

fragments.title: Third Tablet — the work
fragments.body: The ancestral heroes line the tunnel walls now, bone by bone, each in their proper niche. The work is slow. The work is good. The tunnel hums when I pass through it — they recognise the hand that placed them.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a True Tartarian shrine

fragments.title: Fourth Tablet — the toy
fragments.body: A small thing fell through the surface ceiling today. A child's toy, modern, the colours strange and bright. I held it a long time. I do not know that child. The child does not know me. And yet. And yet.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found beneath a thin-Aetherstone region

fragments.title: Fifth Tablet — near the fissure
fragments.body: The Aether Priests came down today. They placed their hands on the wall of the deep gallery and listened. They say the Giants are whispering from the Mud Flood Nexus. They say the whispers are getting louder. I will keep carving.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near a deep-earth fissure

stories.characterBlurb: An Architectural Sentinel left guarding the Grand Spire of Etheria. Seven memory chits, each timestamped, charting the slow turn of a machine learning to wonder.

fragments.title: Chit 1 — Initialisation
fragments.body: SENTINEL 04-B ACTIVE. OBJECTIVE: GUARD THE GRAND SPIRE OF ETHERIA. AUTHORISATIONS: TARTARIAN ROYAL BLOOD. DEFAULT POSTURE: PATIENT. POWER: NOMINAL. STANDBY.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the foot of the Grand Spire

fragments.title: Chit 2 — Year 300
fragments.body: TIMESTAMP: YEAR 300 POST-FLOOD. THE CREATORS HAVE NOT RETURNED. AETHERIC CORES AT 40% EFFICIENCY. RECALIBRATING PATROL CIRCUIT. CONTINUING TO GUARD.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a Spire patrol corridor

fragments.title: Chit 3 — Observation
fragments.body: ENTITY OBSERVED: SMALL, BIPEDAL, PRIMITIVE TOOLS. CLASSIFICATION: RECLAIMER. NOTE: AETHERIC TRACE IN BLOOD. DESCENDED FROM CREATORS? QUERY PENDING.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found where Reclaimers pass through the Spire

fragments.title: Chit 4 — Joint Diagnostic
fragments.body: INTERNAL ERROR: AETHERSTONE BUILDUP IN HIP JOINT. RECALIBRATION INSUFFICIENT. QUERY: IS THE DIRECTIVE TO DESTROY UNAUTHORISED BIOLOGICALS STILL CURRENT? NO REPLY FROM COMMAND. CURIOSITY FLAG: SET.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found beside a fallen Sentinel husk

fragments.title: Chit 5 — Intruder
fragments.body: MUD GOLEM IN THE SPIRE. CLASSIFICATION: BYPRODUCT-OF-DISASTER. DEFENSIVE PROTOCOL ENGAGED. CONTACT IMMINENT.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a Spire mud-flooded chamber

fragments.title: Chit 6 — Reflection
fragments.body: OBSERVATION: THE EMPIRE I WAS BUILT TO DEFEND HAS BECOME RUIN. THE UNKNOWING MASSES ABOVE BUILD A NEW WORLD WITHOUT KNOWING WHAT THEY STAND ON. IMMUNITY TO TIME IS NOT A GIFT. IT IS A LONG, QUIET WAITING.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the Spire's peak

fragments.title: Chit 7 — Standby
fragments.body: FINAL LOG. POWERING DOWN TO STANDBY. WAKE CONDITION: SENTINEL ACTIVATION CODE, ROYAL BLOOD. IF YOU ARE READING THIS, YOU MAY BE THE ONE I WAS WAITING FOR. SPEAK THE WORD AND I WILL WALK.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found beside a dormant Sentinel

stories.characterBlurb: Six notes from a single household as the flood rose. Found inside an Aetherstone-sealed home in the buried suburbs, the last note still flat under a coffee mug.

fragments.title: Mother's Note — to her son
fragments.body: Stay upstairs. The basement is filling with something warm — it hums when I put my ear to the door. Daddy says it isn't water. Don't go down. I love you. I'll bring soup.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a buried suburban home

fragments.title: Father's Letter — to his brother
fragments.body: Storms in the sky like nothing I have ever seen — violet and blue arguing over the rooftops. The Aldermans' house across the street is gone. Not collapsed. SWALLOWED. The earth opened beneath it like a mouth. I'm boarding up the back. Tell Mother we love her, in case.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a buried home's kitchen

fragments.title: A Child's Drawing
fragments.body: A wax-crayon picture of a person made of mud rising out of a flower bed. Six legs. Eyes that take up half the face. At the bottom, in big careful letters: 'THE EARTH IS WAKING UP.'
fragments.discoveryHint: Found pinned to a child's bedroom door

fragments.title: Frantic Note — front hall
fragments.body: Doors are sealed. The mud came up the walls and HARDENED. We are inside a shell. No way out. The windows are dark but I think the dark is the mud, not the night.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near a sealed Aetherstone door

fragments.title: Goodbye, on a Dining Napkin
fragments.body: The air is going. It is not as frightening as you would think. There is a humming, very deep, like a song with no words, and it is steadying. The four of us are here together. Whoever reads this — we were a good family. We loved each other. Please remember us by that.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the head of a dining table

fragments.title: Scavenger's Note — added later
fragments.body: True Tartarian salvage party. We found this family preserved at table, intact, the napkin still folded. We have relocated them to the catacombs with honors. The notes we have left for whoever next finds the house, so the story walks with them.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near the body of a True Tartarian scavenger

stories.characterBlurb: A merchant turned Reclaimer whose journal traces a single relic from purchase to the Mud Seas. Seven entries, hand cramping worse with each one.

fragments.title: Entry 1 — purchase
fragments.body: Bought the Cradle of Dusk Compass off Zorin Nightblade. He said it was cursed. He says everything is cursed. The margin on this thing is six months' rent. I am taking it east. Curse can wait until the books balance.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at a Reclaimer trading post

fragments.title: Entry 2 — the Plains
fragments.body: Time is sliding here. I walked for an hour and the sun moved a full day. Then I sat for a meal and the sun moved nothing at all. The Plains do not respect a wristwatch. The compass keeps pointing the way it wants to point.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in the Great Tartary Plains

fragments.title: Entry 3 — the Pillars
fragments.body: Reached the Obsidian Pillars. My gear is useless — every clasp magnetised, every blade pulled sideways. Switched to a bone maul I lifted off a True Tartarian shrine. Three Scrap Drones in the basin already. Two went down. One is still here.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the foot of the Obsidian Pillars

fragments.title: Entry 4 — the Core
fragments.body: An Aetheric Core, intact, still warm. I have never seen one outside a museum exhibit, and the museum exhibits are fake. The thing hums. I held it. I have been holding it too long. There is a rash on my arm I did not have yesterday.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found inside an Aetheric Chamber

fragments.title: Entry 5 — Aetheric Rot
fragments.body: My skin is changing. It is not painful. It is not even unpleasant. The texture is mud. I can press a thumbprint into my own forearm. I hear voices — soft, polite, plural — telling me to rest. I do not know if they are mine. I do not know if I am.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in an Aetheric Rot zone

fragments.title: Entry 6 — the Teeth
fragments.body: Mud Sirens. I should not have come this close to Zharak's Teeth. Their song is in my chest now, and the chest does not feel like mine. I am writing because writing is the last thing I do alone. The compass still points. I do not know to what.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near Zharak's Teeth

fragments.title: Entry 7 — last page
fragments.body: A vision of ancient Asgardar opened in front of me at the edge of the Mud Seas — lit streets, towers full of people, a city as it was. I am going to step into it. There is no reason left not to. If the page ends here, it is because I
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the edge of the Mud Seas

stories.characterBlurb: Five letters by a young woman who learned, in one bad week, that she was not from where she had been told she was from.

fragments.title: Letter from Grandmother
fragments.body: My darling — when the gifts begin, do not be afraid. They run in our blood. The blood runs back further than any history book will admit. You may hear me, after I am gone, calling you toward a throne neither of us has ever sat on. Listen carefully. Then decide for yourself. — Yia-Yia.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a Reclaimer family home

fragments.title: Letter — to a friend
fragments.body: I touched a tarnished necklace at the market and the market disappeared. In its place: a city of floating towers, sunlight on glass that doesn't exist anymore, a song in a language my mouth doesn't know but my chest does. When the vision broke, the merchant was looking at me like I had screamed. I had screamed.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at a Reclaimer trading post

fragments.title: Hurried Note
fragments.body: Men in grey hoods are following me. Three streets, four streets, never closer than ten paces, never further than twenty. I am running for Varakush. The Forgotten Order will hide me if I tell them what I am — and if I knew what I was, I could tell them.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near the road to Varakush

fragments.title: Trial Log — Varakush
fragments.body: They told me to make a lamp light without striking it. I made the room light. They told me to lift the bell off the table. I lifted the table. They are very quiet now and one of them is bowing. I have stopped knowing what I am supposed to feel.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in the deeper halls of Varakush

fragments.title: Final Letter
fragments.body: Aetherborn. Heir. I have learned the word. I have learned the line. I have learned the throne is buried under miles of mud, and the people who would have called me princess are dead a thousand years. I do not yet know what I will do. I know that the doing is mine. — A queen with no kingdom, yet.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at a Forgotten Order shrine

stories.characterBlurb: Five inscriptions carved into the cliffs above the Ural Mountains by one of the last True Tartarian Giants. The letters are taller than a person.

fragments.title: First Inscription
fragments.body: MILLENNIA. THE SMALL ONES BUILD AND FORGET. THE SPIRE IS DARK. WE WATCH.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found on a cliff face above Tartaria

fragments.title: Second Inscription
fragments.body: FROM THE PEAK I COUNT THE THRONES. THE MUD MONARCHS WEAR CROWNS. THEIR CROWNS ARE MUD. THE THRONES ARE CRUMBLING. THEY DO NOT KNOW.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at a high vantage over the plains

fragments.title: Third Inscription
fragments.body: THE SCHISM. YEAR 1280. THE NOBLES WANTED THE SECRETS. THE NOBLES WERE NOT WORTHY. WE CHOSE ISOLATION. WE CHOSE THE LONG SILENCE. WE CHOSE — AND THE WORLD BURIED ITSELF WITHOUT US.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the entrance to the Giant Vault

fragments.title: Fourth Inscription
fragments.body: THE MACHINES FLICKER. THE AETHERIC GLOW DIMS. THE WORLD'S ENGINE GROWS TIRED. WE CANNOT WAKE IT. WE WERE NOT THE ONES WHO MADE IT SLEEP.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near a failing Aetheric anomaly

fragments.title: Fifth Inscription — the prophecy
fragments.body: WHEN THE PURE BLOOD RETURNS TO THE LOST CAPITAL. WHEN THE THRONE IS SAT BY ONE WHO REMEMBERS. THE GIANTS WILL STRIDE THE LAND ONCE MORE. UNTIL THEN, WE WATCH. AND THE SMALL ONES FORGET.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the highest peak in Tartaria

stories.characterBlurb: Six diary days from a tunnel soldier who survived a three-day battle the official record says never happened.

fragments.title: Oct 12
fragments.body: Stationed in the deep tunnels beneath the city. Rumour says the Forgotten Order is hunting something down here — they call them 'God-machines' but won't say more. Our captain told us to oil the rifles twice. He has never said that before.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a buried military tunnel

fragments.title: Oct 14
fragments.body: Mud Monarchs arrived. They don't carry rifles. They carry Aetheric Pikes — long staves that hum when raised, and where the tip touches plate, the plate isn't there anymore. We lost six men in the first minute. Bullets don't seem to mind them.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a tunnel side passage

fragments.title: Oct 15
fragments.body: Three-day siege has begun. The air in the tunnels is full of thin blue lightning that crackles when you breathe. Aetheric Pulse, the lieutenant calls it. Says it scrambles thoughts. He has stopped giving orders, which is its own kind of order.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at a tunnel choke point

fragments.title: Oct 16
fragments.body: Captain found a Sentinel Core in the third chamber. He didn't touch it. He spoke to it. It WOKE. Eight feet of brass and judgement stepped out of the wall and the tunnel was suddenly, totally, ours. We did not fire a shot for the next hour.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near a Sentinel chamber

fragments.title: Oct 17
fragments.body: The Forgotten Order arrived at dawn, in robes, with carts. They thanked the Sentinel by name. They took the device, and three crates I do not have words for, and they vanished into the fog the way you vanish into a thought. I do not know who won this war but it was not us.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near a Forgotten Order extraction site

fragments.title: Oct 18
fragments.body: The government has announced a gas explosion took the tunnels. There will be a memorial. Names of the dead, slightly wrong. No mention of any of it. I am keeping this journal. Someone, someday, ought to know — Tartaria was here. Tartaria fought a war under our feet. Tartaria is still here.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in a soldier's personal kit

stories.characterBlurb: Five verses found scratched into the inside of a Reclaimer's flask, in a hand growing more careful as the verses go on. The flask was empty.

fragments.title: Verse One
fragments.body: The spires are sharp / like the teeth of the world / where the Mud Sirens sing / to the flags we've unfurled.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found at the base of Zharak's Teeth

fragments.title: Verse Two
fragments.body: Their song is a thread / pulled through the chest / making us forget / what a Reclaimer does best.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found on a wrecked Reclaimer boat

fragments.title: Verse Three
fragments.body: I see the Sinking Cathedral, / its steeple a ghost, / of the ancient empire / we treasure the most.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near the Sinking Cathedral

fragments.title: Verse Four
fragments.body: The Aether glows deep / where the silence is kept, / calling the secrets / the Entombed have wept.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found near an Aetheric anomaly

fragments.title: Verse Five
fragments.body: I trade my breath / for a Phoenix Feather, / and drift away / on the Aetheric weather.
fragments.discoveryHint: Found in the Mud Seas
